name: RTL layout renders correctly for Arabic interface
description: When the interface language is set to Arabic, the layout switches to RTL direction with mirrored navigation and content alignment.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Look for a language toggle or set the interface to Arabic
Verify the page direction changes to RTL (right-to-left)
Verify navigation elements are mirrored to the right side of the page
Verify text content is aligned to the right
